job.name: D0StandaloneProduction
job.command:
set NEVENTS = 1000 set CAMPAIGN = D0JetStandalone_Detroit_v1 set SEED_BASE = 1000011
@ PYTHIA_SEED = ${SEED_BASE} + ${JOBINDEX} set JOB_LABEL = `printf "j%05d" ${JOBINDEX}` set OUTPUT_TAG = "${CAMPAIGN}_${JOB_LABEL}_s${PYTHIA_SEED}_n${NEVENTS}"
set SCRATCH = `pwd` set PROJECT = /gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set OLD_D0WF = /gpfs/mnt/gpfs01/star/pwg/lomicond/Ondrej/Jets/PythiaD0JetGeant/D0EmbeddingClean set BASEJOB = templates/simulation
mkdir -p "${PROJECT}/log" "${PROJECT}/production"
foreach FILE (`grep -rl "${OLD_D0WF}" scripts src templates`) sed -i "s|${OLD_D0WF}|${SCRATCH}|g" ${FILE} end
cp "${FILELIST}" "${BASEJOB}/mudst.selected.list" if ( $status != 0 ) then echo "ERROR: cannot install the job MuDst file list" exit 80 endif
cp scripts/run_standalone_production_v3.csh run_standalone_production_batch.csh if ( $status != 0 ) then echo "ERROR: cannot prepare the batch production wrapper" exit 81 endif
# Each batch process has an isolated scratch directory. The suffix only # distinguishes this run from the default local-test directories. sed -i 's|${NEVENTS}evts_simulation_v1|${NEVENTS}evts_simulation_batch|g' run_standalone_production_batch.csh sed -i 's|${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_v1|${NEVENTS}evts_standalone_batch|g' run_standalone_production_batch.csh
set RUNLOG = "${PROJECT}/log/${OUTPUT_TAG}_${JOBID}.log"
echo "Campaign : ${CAMPAIGN}" >! "${RUNLOG}" echo "Job index : ${JOBINDEX}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "PYTHIA seed : ${PYTHIA_SEED}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "Events : ${NEVENTS}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "Input :" >> "${RUNLOG}" cat "${FILELIST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "" >> "${RUNLOG}"
tcsh run_standalone_production_batch.csh ${NEVENTS} 1 0 ${PYTHIA_SEED} >>&! "${RUNLOG}" set RUN_STATUS = $status
if ( ${RUN_STATUS} != 0 ) then exit ${RUN_STATUS} endif
# The legacy st_physics_* name is kept only inside job scratch because # runBfc uses it. Require exactly one final PicoDst and publish it under # a stable, descriptive production name. set PICOS = ( `find work/jobs -type f -path '*/pico/*.picoDst.root' -print` )
if ( $#PICOS != 1 ) then echo "ERROR: expected exactly one final PicoDst, found $#PICOS" >> "${RUNLOG}" find work/jobs -type f -name '*.picoDst.root' -print >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 90 endif
set PICO = "${PICOS[1]}" set FINALPICO = "${PROJECT}/production/${OUTPUT_TAG}.picoDst.root" set MANIFEST = "${PROJECT}/production/${OUTPUT_TAG}.meta.txt"
if ( ! -s "${PICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: final PicoDst is missing or empty: ${PICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 91 endif
cp -p "${PICO}" "${FINALPICO}" set COPY_STATUS = $status
if ( ${COPY_STATUS} != 0 || ! -s "${FINALPICO}" ) then echo "ERROR: failed to publish final PicoDst: ${FINALPICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 92 endif
echo "campaign=${CAMPAIGN}" >! "${MANIFEST}" echo "job_id=${JOBID}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "job_index=${JOBINDEX}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "pythia_seed=${PYTHIA_SEED}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "requested_events=${NEVENTS}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "input_file_list=${FILELIST}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "input_files:" >> "${MANIFEST}" cat "${FILELIST}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "output=${FINALPICO}" >> "${MANIFEST}" echo "run_log=${RUNLOG}" >> "${MANIFEST}"
echo "Published PicoDst: ${FINALPICO}" >> "${RUNLOG}" echo "Metadata: ${MANIFEST}" >> "${RUNLOG}" exit 0
